note: Micon is an IcoMoon icon manager. Icon packages are `micon` config entities (config_prefix micon -> micon.micon.<id>); the shipped Font Awesome package has id `fa`, so icons are addressed by selector fa-<name> (fa-user, fa-star). Icons resolve via the micon.icon.manager service (MiconIconManager::getIconMatch). Rendering: Twig micon('fa-user'), render #theme micon_icon (icon only) / micon (icon + #title, #position, #icon_only), the #type => 'micon' form element (#packages), and the global micon() function returning a MiconIconize (setIcon/setIconOnly/setIconAfter/addMatchPrefix). Field: type/widget/formatter all id `string_micon` (label Icon); widget setting `packages` = list of micon ids ([] = all). A separate YAML plugin type micon_icons (*.micon.icons.yml, alter hook micon_icons) maps text/regex strings to icon ids. Drush: `drush micon <path>` writes _micon.scss. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real string_micon field type and its form-display widget `packages` setting on the standard Article content type.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the Micon module, how do I output the Font Awesome user icon (fa-user) in (a) a Twig template and (b) a render array? Give the Twig function and the render array #theme key.
evals.expected_output: Twig: {{ micon('fa-user') }} (Micon's Twig function). Render array: ['#theme' => 'micon_icon', '#icon' => 'fa-user'] for icon-only, or '#theme' => 'micon' with '#icon' and '#title' for icon+label.

evals.prompt: I want editors to pick an icon and store it on a content type using the Micon module. What is the field type (and its widget/formatter) I should add, and what does its main widget setting control?
evals.expected_output: Add a field of type string_micon (label 'Icon'); its default widget and formatter are also string_micon. The widget's `packages` setting is a list of micon package ids to offer in the picker (empty = all active packages).

evals.prompt: Using Micon, how do I programmatically attach an icon to a translatable label like 'Save' in PHP so it renders as an icon plus the text? Name the function/method used.
evals.expected_output: Use the global micon() function (or MiconIconizeTrait::micon() in a class): micon('Save')->setIcon('fa-check'). It returns a MiconIconize (a TranslatableMarkup subclass); fluent helpers include setIcon(), setIconOnly(), setIconAfter(), setIconBefore().

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an Icon (string_micon) field named field_micon_known on the Article content type. Its icon-picker widget has been restricted to a single Micon package. Inspect the live default form display for Article and state which package id the widget is limited to.
evals.expected_output: The widget is restricted to the `fa` (Font Awesome) package: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_micon_known component (widget string_micon) has settings.packages containing only `fa`.

evals.prompt: This site has an Article node titled 'Micon Medium Node' with a string_micon Icon field (field_micon_val). Inspect the live site and report the icon id (selector) stored in that field on that node.
evals.expected_output: The stored icon selector is fa-heart (the node's field_micon_val value).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Micon icon field to the Article content type: create a field named field_micon_task of type string_micon on node/article, and make sure it uses the string_micon widget on the default form display. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.storage.node.field_micon_task has type string_micon, field.field.node.article.field_micon_task exists, and core.entity_form_display.node.article.default has a field_micon_task component with widget type string_micon.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type already has a string_micon field field_micon_pkg whose icon-picker currently offers all packages. Using Micon, restrict that field's widget on the default form display so it only offers the `fa` package. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_micon_pkg component's widget settings.packages contains `fa` (e.g. packages: {fa: fa}), so only the Font Awesome package is offered.
